title: Lost Mary BM600 Mango Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these replacement pods allow you to continue enjoying the same effortless vaping experience without replacing your entire device. Each pack contains two prefilled 2ml disposable pods with 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. With each pod delivering up to 600 puffs (depending on personal usage and vaping style), these convenient replacements offer an easy way to keep your device topped up with your favourite Lost Mary flavours. Simply remove the old pod, click in a new one, and enjoy a consistently satisfying vape. The Triple Mango flavour is an exotic blend of three mango profiles, creating a rich and layered, sun-soaked tropical vape. The deep, pulpy sweetness of ripe mango is balanced by delicate citrus undertones, delivering a smooth and juicy inhale with a naturally sweet and lingering finish. Perfect for vapers who enjoy full-bodied tropical fruit flavours, the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods provide a convenient and cost-effective way to experience the signature Lost Mary BM600 range.
